thread:
Alex: FYI @channel — got vendor advisories for a chain affecting grpc + oauth/jwt + net/http (CVE-2026-1456, CVE-2026-1461). Need quick triage; looks like S2S auth flows could be impacted.

Maria: links and short summaries please.

Alex: gist: grpc header parsing allows crafted headers to bypass some middleware checks; oauth lib has token validation edge-case around alg/ordering; stdlib net/http changed header canonicalization between go1.19 -> go1.20 causing mismatches for non-standard headers. PoC from researcher shows forwarded tokens can be misrouted.

Kevin: affected deps we pull in: google.golang.org/grpc, golang.org/x/oauth2, and stdlib differences tied to Go toolchain. Services most at risk: internal microservices and Dedicated endpoints that forward authorization headers.

Julie: set priority: HIGH for token-forwarding services, MEDIUM for pure read-only frontends. We need owner blast.

Alex: proposed remediation checklist:
- enumerate modules across repos with `go list -m -json all`
- create branch per service pinning patched module versions (or vendor for old toolchains)
- run full auth integration + KMS signing tests in staging
- canary to 5% on Dedicated with auditing and 401/500 monitoring
- fallback: compatibility middleware to normalize headers if regressions seen

Maria: commands I ran locally:
```
go list -m -json all | jq -r '.Path + " " + .Version'
# example pin
go get google.golang.org/grpc@v1.56.0 golang.org/x/oauth2@v0.4.0
go mod tidy
```

Kevin: note: some repos still build with go1.18 in Private deployments. For those, vendor the patched modules and commit vendor/ to avoid toolchain bumps during the hotfix.

Julie: CI changes: add gating smoke that fails on auth-related regression signals (spike in 4xx/5xx). Also run audit-log verifier post-deploy.

sec-bot: automated: draft alert "auth_token_error_rate" created at 3x baseline, notifications to #incidents and #eng-oncall.

Alex: discussion: should we force `go 1.20` in go.mod to avoid net/http behavior drift? Some services pinned to 1.18.

Maria: don't mass-bump Go yet. First fix by pinning modules and vendor where necessary. Schedule Go toolchain bump as separate change with its own validation window.

Kevin: compatibility middleware idea to buy rollback time:
```
func tokenCompat(next http.Handler) http.Handler {
  return http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request){
    // normalize nonstandard header casing/names used by older clients
    if v := r.Header.Get("X-Auth-Forward"); v == "" {
      if v2 := r.Header.Get("x-auth-forward"); v2 != "" { r.Header.Set("X-Auth-Forward", v2) }
    }
    next.ServeHTTP(w,r)
  })
}
```
This can be toggled by feature flag during canary/rollback.

Julie: audit logging: add an event at token validation boundary with fields: service, principal, result, token_type, kms_key_id. Ensure event reaches ELK and feeds regression detectors.

Alex: KMS: exercise both cloud KMS and HSM (Private) paths in staging. I saw oauth lib fail with tokens where `alg` ordering differed in the JOSE header.

Maria: opening an epic and kicking off Renovate + manual PRs for critical modules. Tentative timeline: 48h for scan + PRs, 72h for validation, canary next week.

Kevin: we need a hotpatch playbook for emergency rollback:
1) revert pin branch and redeploy last-known-good image
2) enable tokenCompat middleware behind flag
3) apply temporary rate limits on inbound S2S auth calls
4) escalate to incident if 401 spike >5%

Julie: tests to add: fuzz token validation entrypoints, run integration harness with mocked KMS returning edge-case alg orders, 30m canary load test with latency + error monitoring.

Alex: I'll inform product and infra (tickets raised). Legal/compliance: ensure sign-off for any audit retention changes from added events.

Maria: owners assigned: grpc -> Kevin, oauth -> Maria, go toolchain bump -> Alex. I'll make PR templates including `replace` and `vendor` snippets.

Kevin: quick replace example for the branch (remove before merge if not needed):
```
replace google.golang.org/grpc => google.golang.org/grpc v1.56.0
replace golang.org/x/oauth2 => golang.org/x/oauth2 v0.4.0
```

Julie: reminder: check downstreams (grpc-gateway, grpc-web). `go mod graph | grep grpc` is helpful to find transitive uses.

Alex: thanks team — update the epic when PRs land and post short verification messages once canaries are ready. If anyone sees abnormal 401s during canary, ping #eng-oncall and tag me. :thumbsup:

Kevin: starting scans, will post PR links when ready.

Maria: KMS integration tests flaky (2/2) — filing follow-up SEC-1284.

Julie: added canary playbook to runbook repo.

sec-bot: reminder: nightly vuln scan scheduled at 02:15 UTC; results will post to this channel.

Alex: closing loop — thanks.

Kevin: 1/5 repos scanned, found 3 pin locations; opening PRs now.

Maria: epic created: https://gojira.internal/browse/SEC-1283

Julie: adding notes to next oncall shift. :pray:
